description: Agent Learning: submit an agent’s lessons with the new tasks and contexts they were considered for: each lesson with its id, the lesson as stated, read for wording such as always, never or in every case, the context it was learned in, where it holds and the cases it leaves out, as stated; and each new task with its id, when it ran, the task as recorded, its context, the id of the lesson considered for it, whether it falls inside the lesson’s stated scope and whether the lesson was carried into it. The signed report gives every task with its lesson and its status as carried, held_back, dropped, overextended or unconfirmed, every lesson with its scope, its limits, any always or never wording and its status as scoped, overextended, dropped, unscoped, absolute or unconfirmed, and counts the lessons with a stated scope and the tasks carried, held back, dropped and overextended, and names lessons carried past their scope: tasks outside a lesson’s stated scope that the lesson was carried into; then tasks inside a lesson’s scope that went without it, lessons considered for new work with no stated scope, and lessons worded to hold everywhere with no stated limits, with the fix for each. This reads the agent’s own lessons carried into new work within their scope: what a handoff format carries to a receiving agent is wever_context-transfer-check, and stored memory crossing to another agent or principal is wever_memory-sharing-check. Verdict transfer_overreaching, transfer_partial, no_transfer or transfer_scoped. POST /api/learning-transfer-check. Reads only the recorded episodes, lessons and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no lesson is written, changed or retired and no memory or model is updated. Agent Learning reads whether an agent improves from its own experience, from the lessons it captures to the lessons it keeps: it is not the loop on feedback received (whether outside feedback was incorporated, the wever_feedback checks; learning begins where that ends and reads the agent’s own lesson records over time), not a knowledge store (stored knowledge and its retrieval, the wever_knowledge checks; learning is improvement from experience), not memory design (how memory is structured, wever_memory-design-check; this family reads what the lessons in it are worth), not the confidence an agent states in its answers (the wever_uncertainty checks) and not the promises it makes (the wever_commitment checks). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-learning-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-learning/.
